Camp Hall Guided Bird Walk

Tweet

Discover something new in Berkeley County! Join us at Camp Hall—a vibrant, up-and-coming commerce park in the heart of the Lowcountry—for a guided bird walk on Saturday, December 5th, from 9 to 11 a.m. Explore scenic trails as an experienced naturalist points out both resident and migratory bird species.

Camp Hall offers more than avian adventures—it’s a dynamic new destination filled with green spaces, innovative businesses and a strong sense of community. Bring your binoculars, a water bottle and your curiosity for a morning of nature and discovery.

*Please note this bird walk will be held at Camp Hall Commerce Park. We will meet at the Refuel gas station: 309 Avian Pavilion Ln, Ridgeville, SC 29472. Remember to wear appropriate footwear and bring a reusable water bottle.
